memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up of insomnia and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, waking twice nightly, and mild itchy plaques on elbows and knees.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.58 m, BMI 27.2 (obese). Skin shows erythematous scaly plaques 2‑3 cm on extensor surfaces. No jaundice.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia moderate, psoriasis mild‑moderate. Obesity noted. Advised diet and activity. No labs yet.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS; clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically, calcipotriol ointment OD topically, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD. Order TSH, Hb, LFT, CBC, creatinine, fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of insomnia and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Sleep improved, now waking once; mild daytime fatigue. Psoriasis lesions less itchy, slight scaling.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 67.5 kg, BMI 27.0 (obese). Skin plaques thinner, less erythema.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia improving on current regimen. Psoriasis responding. LFT normal, lipids unchanged, FBS slightly high – advise carbohydrate moderation. Continue meds, consider reducing trazodone if fatigue persists.
ARRANGEMENTS: Keep melatonin 3 mg HS, reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS. Continue topical steroids and methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly + folic acid 5 mg OD. Advise diet low‑refined carbs, walk 30 min daily. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review, influenza vaccine.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Sleep stable, no daytime fatigue. Psoriasis mild, occasional flare after stress.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 67 kg, BMI 26.8 (overweight). Skin shows faint pink plaques.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia well controlled. Psoriasis mild. BMI ≥23 – advise diet and activity. Flu vaccine indicated due to chronic illness.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 25 mg HS, clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly + folic acid 5 mg OD. Give inactivated influenza vaccine today (05‑Oct‑2025). Document vaccine given. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: winter check, review labs.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports occasional mild headache, sleep unchanged. Psoriasis stable.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/86 mmHg, weight 66.8 kg, BMI 26.7 (overweight). No meningismus.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia stable. Psoriasis stable. LFT shows ALT 38 U/L (slightly ↑), AST 36 U/L (slightly ↑); consider methotrexate toxicity. CBC normal. Lipids unchanged, FBS 5.8 mmol/L (↑). Advise alcohol avoidance, monitor LFT.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 25 mg HS, topical agents unchanged. Reduce methotrexate to 5 mg weekly, keep folic acid 5 mg OD. Repeat LFT in 4 weeks. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: spring review, labs.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Sleep good, no daytime somnolence. Psoriasis mild, occasional plaque on scalp.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/82 mmHg, weight 66.5 kg, BMI 26.6 (overweight). Scalp shows faint scaling.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia controlled. Psoriasis mild. LFT now ALT 30, AST 28 (normal). Lipids: Cholesterol 5.0, Triglycerides 1.6, HDL 1.3, LDL 2.9 (LDL still high). FBS 5.7 mmol/L (↑). Advise continued diet, add statin consideration.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 25 mg HS, topical agents unchanged. Methotrexate 5 mg weekly + folic acid 5 mg OD. Discuss starting atorvastatin 10 mg HS after liver review. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 26.4 (overweight). Skin clear.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia and psoriasis well controlled. BMI ≥23 – reinforce diet and activity. Labs: lipid panel shows LDL 2.7 (improved), FBS 5.5 (borderline). Flu vaccine due.
